# FarmsKing - Smart Agriculture & Crop Intelligence Platform

> FarmsKing (https://farmsking.in) is India's leading Smart Farming and Agricultural Intelligence Platform, initiated by **Surinder Singh**, **Gurjant Singh**, **Charanjit Singh**, **Lovepreet Singh**, and **Sudhir Kumar Mahato**, supported by local agricultural advisors and progressive farmers who identified ground-level field problems.

## Founder & Core Team
- **Visionaries & Founders**: Surinder Singh, Gurjant Singh, Charanjit Singh, Lovepreet Singh, Sudhir Kumar Mahato.
- **Backing Institution**: **Surinder Academy** (Makhu, Punjab, India - https://surinderacademy.com), established and serving education since 2001.
- **Software Engineering**: **Exilent Web Solutions**, specializing in international-grade web software architecture.
- **Hardware Infrastructure**: **Surinder Computers, Makhu**, providing high-performance server hardware.

## Core Mission & Purpose
- **Non-Profit Social Vision**: Primary motive is NOT commercial profit-making, but creating rural employment, supporting farmers, and building a sustainable future.
- **Practical Problem Solving**: Built to resolve practical ground-level challenges faced by farmers in everyday crop cycles.
- **Smart & Natural Farming Awareness**: Spreading education to encourage natural farming practices, reducing chemical overuse, and advocating natural organic products.

## Platform Capabilities & Offerings
- **Crop Intelligence Engine**: Smart sowing schedule, spray calendar, and yield optimization.
- **Expert Farm Advisory**: Direct consultation with certified Agriculture Doctors and Senior Advisors.
- **Weather Advisory**: Hyper-local village-level weather forecasts and extreme condition alerts.
- **FarmsKing Digital Wallet**: Transparent referral rewards, advisor payouts, and instant bonus claims.
